title: Scout Perform
description: A performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed for low-end and mid-range systems, improving FPS, loading times, and overall game responsiveness with optional immersion and quality-of-life features.
body:
# Scout Perform

Scout Perform is a performance-focused version of Scout Client, designed to improve FPS, reduce loading times, and optimise overall gameplay responsiveness. It trades some compatibility for stronger performance tuning and a more streamlined mod set.

<details>
<summary>Optimisations/Improvements</summary>

- Better memory usage  
- Dynamic FPS usage  
- Faster loading  
- Faster chunk loading  
- Overlay optimisations  
- Terrain generation optimisations  
- Texture fixes  
- General rendering optimisations  
- Reduced background processing for smoother gameplay  

</details>

<details>
<summary>Features</summary>

- Game immersion  
  - More footstep sounds  
- Camera zoom  
- No chat restrictions  
- Animations  
- Detailed crash logs  
- Crash helper  
- Inventory immersion  
  - Item highlighting  
  - Particles  
  - Sounds  
- Voice chat  
- Map  
- All-version compatibility (ViaVersion)  

</details>

<details>
<summary>Shaders</summary>

Shaders are supported in Scout Perform.

To enable shaders, go to:  
Options > Video Settings > Beryl > Shaders

Shader packs are NOT supported though.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Benchmarking</summary>

Scout Perform has been tested on a new world and achieves 100+ FPS under default settings.

Test system:
- NVIDIA RTX 3050  
- Ryzen 5 5500  
- 32GB DDR4 RAM  

Results may vary depending on settings, world type, and hardware.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Compatibility Note</summary>

Scout Perform prioritises performance over broad compatibility. Adding extra mods may cause instability. It is recommended to keep backups before making changes.

</details>

<details>
<summary>About Scout</summary>

Scout Client has two versions: Scout Client and Scout Perform. Scout Perform focuses more heavily on performance improvements, while Scout Client is designed to balance performance and quality-of-life features.

</details>
